messages:
raj: quick check — PR #4821 changes how we store onprem credentials. Moves instance creds into tenant-scoped KV + narrows SA scopes. Anyone worried about VPC connectors, egress, or KMS policy? pinging @emma @taylor. TL;DR: aims to reduce global secret surface before Dedicated rollout. :pray:

emma: skimmed it. main thought: we need an explicit KMS binding for the tenant service account in the onprem template. Otherwise decrypt will fail in air-gapped envs. See snippet below.

emma: ```
kmsBinding:
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
    - serviceAccount:tenant-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

taylor: :eyes: also confirm that the KV has replication disabled for onprem. We don't want cross-region replication to leak metadata. PR shows default replication: multi-region — can you make it region: local?

raj: good catch. I set replication: regional by mistake. I'll change to 'regional: local' and add k8s sa config. Will push new commit in ~30m. Any blockers for merge window today 16:00 UTC?

dana: ops note: if you change SA names we'll need a quick infra deploy to bind the policy. I can do it but need 20m heads-up. If you aim for 16:00, push by 15:30 pls.

sec-bot: sec-scan: PR #4821: flagged 'missing-kms-binding' — high priority. Re-run after the binding is added.

emma: :thumbsup: looks good. Also add a short note in the onprem README about manual KMS step and add a tests/ci check to fail if kmsBinding missing.

raj: will add README snippet + CI check. tagging for final lgtm @emma @taylor. Thanks.

taylor: LGTM after the kmsBinding and replication fix. :white_check_mark:
